name: The Chaos Rift
realm: Reality tears. Things go wrong here - on purpose.
lesson: When something goes wrong, throw an exception. Risky code goes inside try; handlers are catch blocks (catch by const reference). If nothing catches it, the program terminates. <stdexcept> offers runtime_error, out_of_range and friends; catch(...) catches anything.

trial.prompt: Which keyword begins the protected block?
Exceptions should usually be caught by…

trial.code:
try { throw 42; }
catch (int x) { cout << x + 1; }

boss.explain: The throw skips the rest of try.

boss.prompt: What happens to an uncaught exception?

spell.prompt: Write int safeDivide(int a, int b) that throws runtime_error("div by zero") when b is 0, otherwise returns a / b.
